name: Kim est une fille
source:
Our hero, a non-binary person, gets lost in their dark rumination, following the revelation that their girlfriend, Kim, no longer wishes to use "They/Them" pronouns and instead decided to fully go by "She", and to fully assume herself as a woman.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201126202540/https://themoe.itch.io/kimisagirl-kimestunefille]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我们的英雄，一个非二元性别的人，在得知他们的女朋友金不再希望使用“他们/他们”代词，而是决定完全使用“她”，并完全将自己视为女性之后，迷失在他们的黑暗沉思中。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201126202540/https://themoe.itch.io/kimisagirl-kimestunefille]itch.io[/url]]
